A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

(1) we propose a novel approach that jointly embeds all relation types from multiple input KBs and textual patterns expressing relations, which is the first work that addresses multilingual relation extraction using a single model; (2) we employ a LSTM to compositionally embed the semantics of textual patterns; (3) we demonstrate the flexibility of this approach by evaluating on the English and the Spanish TAC KBPs benchmarks, in which the training data entities overlap but the test data do not; and
we are able to learn a multilingual relation extractor by using the English training data, which can be applied to extract relations in a new language.
we propose a novel method for multilingual relation extraction, which can be applied to any language.

the ability of an LSTM to compose the semantics of relational patterns is crucial in order to generalize to previously unseen relations and to generalize across languages.
compositionality is crucial for multilingual relation extraction.
